risk.safe_hint: Recreated automatically by its app. No personal data.
risk.review_hint: May still be in use or contain personal data.
risk.danger_hint: Shown for information only. Cannot be selected.

onboarding.welcome_body: Sapu shows you what fills your disk, cleans what is safe, and removes duplicate files. Everything it removes can be restored.
onboarding.profile_body: This only changes how much detail you see. You can switch any time.
onboarding.profile_general_hint: Plain language, sensible defaults picked for you.
onboarding.profile_developer_hint: Docker, node_modules, package caches, build output.
onboarding.profile_suggested: Suggested: we found {{tools}} on this computer.
onboarding.access_body_macos: macOS stops apps from reading some folders. To let Sapu see the whole disk, grant Full Disk Access.
onboarding.access_body_windows: Sapu works without admin rights. Running as administrator makes scans faster and more complete, but it is optional.
onboarding.access_body_linux: Sapu only reads folders your account can access. System folders are shown for information only.
onboarding.access_steps_macos_1: Click the button above to open System Settings at Full Disk Access.
onboarding.access_steps_macos_2: If Sapu is not in the list, click + and pick the Sapu app. The button below shows where it is.
onboarding.access_steps_macos_3: Turn on the switch next to Sapu, then come back here. The status updates automatically.
onboarding.safety_trash: Everything removed goes to the Trash / Recycle Bin, never deleted outright.
onboarding.safety_history: Every clean-up is logged in History, so you can restore it.
onboarding.safety_protected: System folders and personal data are protected. Sapu will never touch them.
onboarding.safety_preview: You always see a summary before anything is removed.
onboarding.ai_body: AI only suggests and explains. It can never delete files. Only file names, sizes and ages are sent, never file contents.
onboarding.ai_cloud: Cloud with your own API key
onboarding.ai_cloud_hint: Metadata is sent to the provider you choose.
onboarding.scan_body: The first scan shows what is taking up space. Nothing is removed at this stage.
onboarding.scan_unavailable: Scanning arrives in the next version. For now, explore History and Settings.
onboarding.language_body: Choose the display language. You can change it any time in Settings.
onboarding.access_dev_note: The development build runs as a plain program, so it has to be added manually with the + button.
onboarding.access_run_admin_hint: The app reopens with admin rights. Optional.

home.title: Home
home.intro: How this computer is doing right now.
home.action_clean_hint: Temporary files and caches, by rule.
home.hero_never: Never scanned. One click shows what takes up space.
home.tile_scan_body: See what takes up space, by category and folder.
home.tile_clean_body: Temporary files, caches and leftovers, safely to the Trash.
home.tile_dedupe_body: Identical files; one copy is always kept.
home.safety_line: Everything Sapu removes goes to the Trash first and is logged in History.
home.freed_none: No clean-ups yet. Start with Scan.
home.tile_care_body: One click: scan, check, and clean what is safe.

history.title: Clean-up history
history.empty_body: Every clean-up will be listed here so you can restore it.
history.restore_unsupported: On macOS, open the Trash in Finder to restore files.
history.not_in_trash: {{count}} files no longer in the Trash

settings.title: Settings
settings.protected_body: Sapu will never remove these, no matter what.
settings.notify: Notify when a long operation finishes
settings.notify_hint: Useful when you leave the app while it scans.

errors.validation: The file changed since the scan, so it was skipped.
errors.restore_unsupported: Automatic restore is not available on this system.
errors.io: Could not read from or write to the disk.
errors.serde: The data could not be read.
errors.rules: The clean-up rules could not be loaded.
errors.no_evaluation: Check what can be cleaned first.
errors.plan: The removal plan is not valid.
errors.ai_provider: Could not reach the AI provider. Check the address, model or API key.
errors.ai_bad_answer: The AI answer could not be read. Try again.
errors.ai_keychain: Could not access the system keychain.

scan.title: Scan
scan.intro: Choose what to look at. Scanning only reads; nothing is changed.
scan.target_home_hint: Your documents, photos, downloads and projects. The usual choice.
scan.target_disk_hint: Includes the system and apps. Takes longer.
scan.cancelled_note: The scan was stopped. The results below are incomplete.
scan.denied_note: {{count}} folders could not be read due to permissions. The results are still usable.
scan.map_hint: Click a folder to go inside. Box size matches the space used.
scan.trash_body: {{count}} items ({{size}}) will be moved to the Trash. You can restore them from the Trash or from History.
scan.trash_protected: This location is protected and cannot be moved.
scan.stale_note: Some items were moved. Scan again to refresh the numbers.
scan.size_note: Sizes are the space actually used on disk, not logical file sizes.
scan.sun_hint: Click a ring to go inside, click the centre to go up. Add to the basket, then move everything at once.
scan.basket_empty: The basket is empty. Pick a folder or file in the rings.
scan.next_clean_body: {{size}} can go without risk, all to the Trash first.
scan.next_dupes_body: Check this folder for files with identical contents.
scan.next_largest_body: The biggest files and folders, ready to review one by one.

clean.title: Clean
clean.intro: Sapu looks for files that are safe to remove using clear rules. Nothing is removed until you press the button.
clean.empty_body: Every rule was checked and found nothing to clean for this profile.
clean.preview_body: {{rules}} rules, {{items}} items, about {{size}}. Files go to the Trash and are logged in History.
clean.preview_permanent: Includes emptying the Trash: its contents are gone for good. Tick to continue.
clean.preview_permanent_ack: I understand the Trash contents cannot be restored
clean.preview_volume_warning: Docker volumes can hold database data. Make sure none is still needed.
clean.projects_body: Build output and dependencies that can be recreated. Folders with git-tracked files are never offered.

dedupe.title: Duplicates
dedupe.intro: Find files whose contents are identical. One copy is always kept; the rest can go to the Trash.
dedupe.stage_1: Collecting files of the same size
dedupe.stage_2: Comparing the start and end of files
dedupe.cancelled_note: The search was stopped. The results below are incomplete.
dedupe.empty_body: No two files with identical contents were found in this folder.
dedupe.headline: {{size}} can be freed
dedupe.headline_sub: {{groups}} groups, {{files}} duplicate files out of {{seen}} checked
dedupe.pairs_body: These folders contain the same files.
dedupe.preview_body: {{files}} files from {{groups}} groups, {{size}}. One copy per group stays. Everything can be restored from the Trash or History.
dedupe.keep_missing: Group skipped: the kept file no longer exists
dedupe.hardlink_hint: The path stays and points to the kept file. Space is still freed. Same disk only.
dedupe.strategy_folder: The one in my main folders

ai.label: AI suggestion
ai.show_payload: See the data that is sent
ai.payload_note: Only this is sent to {{provider}} ({{model}}). File contents are never sent.
ai.off_hint: AI help is off. Turn it on in Settings.
ai.save_rule_hint: This folder will appear in Clean as your own yellow rule.
ai.rule_saved: Rule saved. It appears in Clean after the next check.
ai.search_placeholder: Search with a sentence, e.g. videos over 1 GB untouched for a year
ai.settings_body: AI only suggests and can never delete files. Only names, sizes and ages are sent.
ai.no_models: No models installed or the server is unreachable.
ai.api_key_hint: Stored in the system keychain, not in a file.
ai.anonymize: Hide the account name and home folder
ai.copied_rule: Rule copied. See CONTRIBUTING.md to propose it to the community.

care.title: Care
care.intro: One click: Sapu scans your home folder, checks the clean-up rules, then gives a Space Score and the safest next steps. Nothing is removed until you press the button.
care.stage_2: Checking what is safe to clean
care.score_great: Your disk is roomy and tidy.
care.score_good: Pretty good, a little can be tidied.
care.score_fair: Getting crowded. The steps below will help.
care.score_poor: The disk is nearly full. Start with what is safe.
care.rec_clean_safe: Clean {{size}} that is safe. Everything goes to the Trash first.
care.rec_review: Review {{size}} that may still be in use, in Clean.
care.rec_stale: {{count}} development projects untouched for over a month, {{size}}.
care.done_body: {{size}} freed. The Space Score updates when you care again.
